transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, well... I guess I just don't really care about much lately. Like, things I used to do... dance class, or hiking, or whatever. Even trying to cook something new or... game nights. They just feel like... chores now, I guess. I just keep putting them off.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I feel sad all day or anything. Just... like I said, I just don't really care.
Do you ever feel down or depressed for a good part of the day, even if it's not all day?
Um, no. I don't think so. It's not really... sadness. I just don't feel like doing much, like I said.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even if you’re not doing much?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I'm extra tired or anything. I just... don't want to do much.
Do you find yourself feeling down or in a depressed mood for a significant part of most days, even if it's not all day?
Um... no. I don't think so. Like I said... it's not really sadness. I just... I don't know.
Do you still enjoy things that used to make you happy, like spending time with friends or watching your favorite shows?

Um... no, not really. That's kind of why I came in. I just... I barely care about the things that used to make me feel like myself. Like... dance class, or hiking... even trying new recipes or game night. I don't know. They all just feel like chores now. I just keep putting them off.
Would you say you've completely stopped enjoying things that used to make you happy, even a little bit?
I mean... not completely, I guess. I don't know. If I actually do them, maybe it's okay for a minute. It's just... hard to care.
Would you say that you take no pleasure in things that you used to enjoy, even a little bit?

Um... like I was just saying... I just barely care anymore. All those things I mentioned before, like the hiking or game nights... they just sit there like chores now. I just keep putting them off. So... yeah, I guess I don't really get much out of them.

Would you say that you’ve lost interest or pleasure in all, or almost all, activities that you used to enjoy, even things like eating, spending time with friends, or watching something you like on TV?

Yeah... like I said... I just barely care anymore. I don't know why we keep going over this. I told you, things like dance class or hiking... trying new recipes... they just feel like chores now. I put them off. I don't really enjoy them anymore.
Do you have days where you feel sad or down, even if it doesn’t last all day or feels like it comes and goes?
Um... I guess so. Sometimes. I don't know, just... normal sad, I think.
Do you feel down or depressed for most of the day, even if it's not every day?
No... not really. It's not like an all-day thing. Just... sometimes, like I said.
Would you say that, over the past two weeks, you’ve felt down or in a depressed mood for a significant part of most days, even if it wasn’t all day?
No. I... I already said. It's not most days. Just sometimes.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, like eating much less than usual or losing weight without trying?
Um... no. Not really. I eat about the same, I guess. I haven't really been paying attention to my weight.
Over the past two weeks, have there been several days where you felt down or in a depressed mood for a good part of the day, even if not all day?
Um... I'm not really sure. Maybe a couple days? I don't really keep track of it like that. Just... here and there, I guess.

Can you say for sure if there have been several days in the past two weeks where you felt down or in a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even if it wasn’t most of the day or every day?
I... I can't really say for sure. Like I just said, I don't keep track of it. I don't think it's been several days, no.
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or in a depressed mood for a good part of the day, even if it wasn’t every day or all day long?
I mean... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said... no. I don't think so. I'm just... fine, I guess.
Over the past two weeks, have you had several days where you felt down or in a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even if not every day or all day long?
I... I don't really know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. Like I keep saying... no. I haven't.
Would you say that over the past two years, you’ve had more days than not where you felt down or in a low mood, even if it wasn’t all day?
Two years? I... I don't know. No, I don't think so. I don't really focus on that kind of thing. I just... I just try to get through the day.
Over the past two weeks, have there been at least five days where you felt down or in a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even if it wasn’t all day or every day?
I... I really don't understand why we're still on this. I told you, no. I haven't been depressed. I'm just tired of answering the same question.
Over the past two weeks, have you had at least several days where you felt down or in a depressed mood for a significant part of the day, even if it wasn’t every day or all day long?
I... I don't know what you want me to say. I just told you no. The answer hasn't changed.
